faq.intro: These answers describe how the site works. What governs a promotion is its Official Rules.

q1.answer: Lone Star Winners is an online store. Buying eligible merchandise may earn promotional entries into the promotion described in the Official Rules.
q1.question: What is Lone Star Winners?

q2.answer: No. What you buy is merchandise. Entries are a promotional benefit awarded under the Official Rules, and they are not the product you pay for.
q2.question: Am I buying entries?

q3.answer: Whether a promotion offers a free method of entry, and how it works, is stated in the Official Rules of that promotion.
q3.question: Is there a free way to take part?

q4.answer: Eligibility is defined in the Official Rules of each promotion, and nowhere else on this site.
q4.question: Who may take part?

q5.answer: Winner selection is described in the Official Rules of each promotion. When the drawing is carried out by an independent administrator, the promotion page says so.
q5.question: How is a winner selected?

q6.answer: The promotion page keeps reporting where the process stands: with the administrator, in winner verification, or complete.
q6.question: What happens after a promotion closes?

pillar1.title: One governing document
pillar1.body: Each promotion is governed by its own Official Rules. Until a promotion has a published version, this site says so instead of filling the gap.

pillar2.title: Designed to keep the origin of every entry
pillar2.body: The entry ledger is designed so that where an entry came from, when it was recorded and what its status is can be reconstructed, and so that no entry is removed in silence: a refund or a reversal is recorded as a movement of its own, never as an edit.

pillar3.title: Ready for an independent administrator
pillar3.body: The platform is built to hand the entry list of a promotion to an independent administrator. When a promotion states that its drawing is conducted by one, its promotion page says so and reports each step of the process.
